title: CAT 2022 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Ability - Averages
subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: The average of three integers is 13. When a natural number $n$ is included, the average of these four integers remains an odd integer. The minimum possible value of $n$ is
questions.explain: The sum of the three integers is $13 \times 3 = 39$. When $n$ is added, the new average is $\frac{39+n}{4}$, which must be an odd integer $2k+1$. So $39+n = 4(2k+1) = 8k+4$. Rearranging, $n = 8k - 35$. Since $n$ is a natural number ($n \ge 1$), we need the smallest $k$ such that $8k - 35 \ge 1$. For $k=5$, $8(5) - 35 = 5$. Thus, the minimum possible value of $n$ is 5.

questions.q: The average weight of students in a class increases by 600 gm when some new students join the class. If the average weight of the new students is 3 kg more than the average weight of the original students, then the ratio of the number of original students to the number of new students is
questions.explain: Let there be $o$ original students with average weight $x$. Let there be $n$ new students with average $x + 3$. The increase in average is 0.6 kg. We have the equation: $\frac{o \cdot x + n(x+3)}{o+n} = x + 0.6$. Expanding this: $ox + nx + 3n = ox + nx + 0.6(o+n) \Rightarrow 3n = 0.6o + 0.6n \Rightarrow 2.4n = 0.6o \Rightarrow \frac{o}{n} = \frac{2.4}{0.6} = 4$. So the ratio is $4 : 1$.
